## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: When this story is complete, an exhaustive consumer list for both llm-api-call.sh and ci-llm-review-runner.sh has been produced and checked in. The list covers scripts, skills, hooks, agent files, GitHub workflow YAML, docs, tests, and fixtures.

## Context
An exhaustive grep has already been performed and all consumers are known:

### llm-api-call.sh consumers
| File | Ref type | Disposition |
|------|----------|-------------|
| plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh | functional (primary) | Replaced by Python module in S3/e596 |
| plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh | functional (secondary, non-CI-review) | Annotated as compat-shim in 4b97 T4 |
| plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md | "Used by" doc | Updated to Python module in 4b97 T2 |
| CLAUDE.md | documentation | Updated in S6/e71e |
| .claude/dso-config.conf | comment | Updated in 4b97 T3 |
| tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh | test for runner | Updated/deleted in S3/e596 |
| tests/scripts/test-llm-api-call.sh | test for script itself | Deleted in S3/e596 |
| tests/scripts/test-claude-md-ci-review.sh | asserts CLAUDE.md reference | Updated in S6/e71e |
| tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh | test stub via _LLM_DISPATCH_CMD | No change needed (uses env var override) |
| .test-index | test mapping | Updated in S3/e596 |

### ci-llm-review-runner.sh consumers
| File | Ref type | Disposition |
|------|----------|-------------|
| .github/workflows/ci.yml | functional invocation | Updated to Python module in S3/e596 |
| plugins/dso/templates/ci-dso-staged.yml | template invocation | Updated in S3/e596 |
| plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md | documentation | Updated in 4b97 T2 |
| plugins/dso/docs/contracts/ci-overlay-flags.md | "Written by" ref | Shim semantics in 4b97 T3 |
| plugins/dso/skills/onboarding/SKILL.md | DSO_ASSETS_DIR description | Updated in 4b97 T3 |
| CLAUDE.md | documentation | Updated in S6/e71e |
| tests/fixtures/violation-credentials.sh | comment | Updated in 4b97 T3 |
| tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-job.sh | tests CI job invocation | Updated with CI workflow in S3/e596 |
| tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh | tests the runner | Updated/deleted in S3/e596 |
| tests/scripts/test-claude-md-ci-review.sh | asserts CLAUDE.md | Updated in S6/e71e |
| tests/scripts/test-host-project-e2e-verify.sh | comment | Minor update in 4b97 T3 |
| .test-index | test mapping | Updated in S3/e596 |

## Implementation Steps
1. Create docs/ci-review-consumer-list.md with the table above (verbatim, properly formatted as Markdown)
2. The file must have two top-level sections: "## llm-api-call.sh consumers" and "## ci-llm-review-runner.sh consumers"
3. Each section must have the disposition table and a "Generated" date
4. Add a header describing the purpose: this is the pre-deletion consumer audit required by S3

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>/dev/null || true
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py 2>/dev/null || echo "lint-ok"
- [ ] docs/ci-review-consumer-list.md exists
  Verify: test -f $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/ci-review-consumer-list.md
- [ ] Consumer list contains llm-api-call.sh section
  Verify: grep -q "llm-api-call.sh" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/ci-review-consumer-list.md
- [ ] Consumer list contains ci-llm-review-runner.sh section
  Verify: grep -q "ci-llm-review-runner.sh" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/ci-review-consumer-list.md
- [ ] Consumer list contains disposition column
  Verify: grep -qi "disposition" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/ci-review-consumer-list.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
